notes.title: Alpha 1.4.5 Arena Update
notes.notes:
- fixed internally suppressed weapons (mp5sd, asval & vss) crashing ppl when u shoot at them lol
- fixed close fire not having correct distance value (always sounds right next to you)
- disabled gbuffer clearing
- disabled  full resolution depth prepassing
- fixed trying to unlock skills crashing client
- gave broken vehicles interior collisions
- fixed large workshop having incorrectly rotated objects
- changed tooltip to say capslock instead of alt for snapping
- fixed build snapping only working on double tapping
- added unlockallskills {steamId} command
- fixed spawn {steamId} or calling spawn from another player for vehicles/workbenches\enemies spawning it at the host
- significantly turned down TAA antiflickering (hopefully will reduce artifacts a lot)
- removed glass on sights having water droplets
- removed ability to pickup while reloading
- fixed night vision not turning off if you die
- significantly increased view distance for night vision
- fixed not being able to put night vision goggles on weapon workbench
- nvgs now work while using console
- interacting with a weapon equipped with a weapon workbench will now put the weapon straight on the workbench
- fixed pistol stock not being pickupable
- fixed bug where sometimes weapons dont chamber if spawned in serverside unchambered
- fixed asset warmup not showing the correct loading state sometimes
- fixed respawning mechanoids not redestroying them
- increased recoil signifcantly for when prone & crouching (prone especially would make basically any gun a complete lazer beam with a 50% recoil reduction), it still helps just less
- switched fallback  AA to SMAA from TAA, this doesnt look as good but hopefully should completely remove artifacting for people using FSR
- turned depth tolerance to 0 for SSGI, hopefully should further reduce artifacting
- fixed not being able to reconnect to servers after being disconnected (yay)
- syncronous mechanoids movement now being synced from server to client
- fixed fiveseven having incorrect attatchment points when using a weapon workbench or dragging in inventory
- added ability to put holosight on fiveseven
- items in toolbelt/backpack now wiggle when dragging around inventory
- fixed not being able to put conpensators on some weapons
- fixed single shot rifle not having barrel attatchment properly attatched to barrel, i.e if you put a suppressor on it and use the break action it would be floating
- changed render stack position of sharpness component to always layer after DLSS so DLSS injection point can be after PostProcess but still render with sharpness after
- fixed issue with unchambered weapons that dont have physical parts that move causing errors
- switched DLSS back to pre post process stack position
- fixed DLSS always being on the wrong quality setting i.e maximum permermance i.e the lowest
- added antialiasing setting (only applys for people not using DLSS)
- new icon for stealing from players
- increased FSR min screen resolution 10% -> 40%
- enabled TAA anti ringing (should help with artifcating )
- changed motion vectors of all scopes & sights (should also  help with over aliasing)
- changed from FSR to TAA upscale for dynamic resolution fallback (people with poo gpus)
- new dynamic AA scaling option which reduces anti flickering & asliasing when ADSing which should lead to much much clearer usage when using optics & sights
- changed way all non TAA rendering works on the backend
- enabled dynamic resolution on  scopes (better fps)
- turned motion vectors back on for sights (not optics)
- temporarily removed inital object render caching... this may significantly reduce ram usage
- reenabled texture streaming (still a client setting) , will hopefully also reduce ram usage
- fixed escape reloading menu if your not loading into a server
- new arena game type (heavily unfinished)
- new console commands to set teams for arena  game type
- new console commands to set team spawns for arena game type
- new consolecommand setarena area to autogenerate team spawns
- added auto positioning when dragging onto attatchments for weapon workbench
- weapon attatchments now use dynamic collider size
- lowered weapon workbench candle bridgtness
- area gamemode now spawns your charachter back with your items, others have a few seconds to grab shit off your body if they want

notes.title: Alpha 1.4.2 Multiplayer Update
notes.notes:
- fixed sand having incorrect normal mapping on distant sand
- made task menu more visible
- significantly reduced health of some armor plating
- fixed car interiors not having collision
- fixed spawns being incorrect on table
- characters always render at full resolution
- fixed large workshop not having collisions
- reduced jump & vaulting stamina use
- fixed tire stack not having collisions
- significnatly thinned thickness of wirebox (locker)
- slightly reduced skuttler night speed
- fixed characters sliding on hills
- fixed t2 trader having item spawns
- items that dont technically have a quality wont show a quality anymore
- fixed planter gobbling your items lol (sorry lucas)
- fixed not being able to put ammo in high quality magazines
- fixed weapons  spawning with ammo in the chamber not showing it
- new keyprompt for flashlight
- bullet count now also counts chamber
- you can now drop things from inventory from dragging not to the edge but just slightly away from things
- fixed random spawn tents not clearing ground
- fixed road going into wooden bridge
- fixed cars spawning on rail
- significantly reduced amount of industrial & farming POI spawns
- fixed truck canopy  not having collision
- increased min distance of higher tier biomes
- improved all sandy beaches biomes
- fixed distance based biome temperature weights not having the correct interpolation value
- introdced horizontal based biome temperature blending
- changed default biome weights around temperate biomes to make finding t2 & t3 biomes not like right next to spawn sometimes
- fixed changing biome weight server settings not rlly working (go nuts)
- changed biome weight settings to a slider between 0 & 2 instead of its exact noise value
- added overall world biome temperature server setting (between -1 & 1)
- new weighted biome system means turing up the weight of biomes will turn down the weight of others in the backend (you dont have to do anything)
- limited min chunk render distance to 2
- fixed blueprints not working for buildables
- added new splash screen images
- fixed turning SSG1 lighting to 0 (enabling indirect fallback) making everything insanely dark and ugly
- fixed being able to place things by moving your mouse really quick
- fixed walk speed serversetting only changing backwards walk speed lol
- fixed unlocking blueprints not working in general
- fixed making new presets override over all existing presets
- fixed some objects being transparent when looked at from certain angles when highlighted red
- fixed turrets looking at the wrong point when trying to detect player making it not spot you sometimes
- fixed taskmanager complaining when joining multiplayer servers
- fixed moving firebarrel making fire trail behind
- presets now have a save button
- putting empty jerrycans in generator/vehicle now just drops it to ground
- when a vehicle turns off it now applys handbrake motion to stop it moving uncontrollably
- decreased max vault height
- fixed vaulting over items you shouldent beable too
- temporarily removed being able to see powerlines on map (this will come back when roads are visible)
- fixed bed spawns in medium house staircases
- fixed toolkit having wrong name
- switched all vehicle upgrade slots to driver side
- fixed voltage box having incorrect collisions
- fixed not being able to put toolkit on car
- fixed build authorization not saving across reloading world
- fixed grass flattening making it spaz out
- fixed reeds being incorrect
- improved road ground flattening
- made nights slightly brighter
- fixed assault backpacks trying to spawn a "combat hatchet" which isnt in the game yet & would break it spawning
- added LODS for claim boxes as they were using an insanely high vertex count
- optimised night light & NVS light it has an insane range
- added LODS for all windows
- added LODS for brick buildings
- added LODS for most industrial based buildings
- added to skills & to inventory text in inventory to make buttons more clear
- multiplayer time
- added new serverside command: getplayers to give steam id of all players on ur server
- connect console command now works
- connect console command also allows connect {steamId} instead of just connect {ipv4}
- new console logs for connecting & disconnecting players
- setup connect localhost fallback testing environemtn for new steamId system
- new always authenticate flag for network authentication layer to allow invalid requests for testing (i.e technically running 2 servers on the same computer is auth invalid so needs to b let thru for testing)
- new console command for this ^^^ authenabled {true/false}
- if sever authentication is disabled, will allow multiple of the same steamId to join the same server, yes this means you can join twice on the same account and your account will be assigned a new SteamId (this is for testing mostly)
- disabling server authentication will also bypass banlist & whitelist checks
- fixed hovering over certain magazines not allowing you to pick them up
- connection localhost will now use kcp udp fallback transport
- disabling auth skips assetwarmup for faster load times
- fixed global chat multiplayer auth error
- added correct spawnentites for vehicles
- fixed dead/other players not having eyes lol
- fixed player state server desyncronization
- fixed clients not being able to see hosts character while host can
- fixed asyncronous network player obfuscation causing players to not be seen sometimes when their close
- SteamId now synced to all clients instead of just the owner of the player object as other players need it for sync
- you can no longer grab items off alive players
- being killed by player will now display their name instead of just id
- fixed client player having collision (pushing its own player)
- fixed killing players disconnecting the host
- teleporting to a player with your weapon out will now corretly equip it
- fixed items showing mild highlight when looking at other players
- fixed workbenches that go out of network obfuscation range still acting as if they exist clientside
- you can no longer steal a players main weapon only things attatched to their toolbelt/backpack
- fixed clients sometimes just drowing for no reason lol
- fixed eyes being too bright
- significnatly increased the rate of client data refreshing, meaning mostly no more waiting ages to beable to see players after teleporting to them (waiting for client data to refresh)
- fixed claimbox LOD being incorrect
